<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/tokens/{token}/log"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists recent requests made with an access token, newest first. Requires the tokenAuditLog setting to be enabled; it is off by default, and entries only exist from the point it was switched on.
